about: The collecta of the formulary “Septuagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O Lord, graciously hear the prayers of Thy people, that we who are justly afflicted for our sins may mercifully be delivered for the glory of Thy name. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
